ruling.recommended_action: Close the case with no refund; note in the trip record that the 17:38–17:49 deviation was covered by the on-route DataMall accident on the optimal route, and remind the driver to message riders in-app before rerouting (no account action).
ruling.reasoning:
RydeTAXI metered trip: the sole off-route segment is F3 (17:38–17:49, 6.56 km driven where the optimal route covers 1.64 km, +4.92 km), which under RD-1 must be tested against RD-3/RD-4/RD-5 before any refund is computed [F3][F1][RD-1]. RD-2 only bites on an unexempted segment; if the segment is exempt, the amount is $0 [F3][RD-2].

RD-4(a): F13 is a DataMall Accident ("Accident on Seletar Expressway (towards TPE) after Woodlands Avenue 12 Exit") reported 17:16, 0 m from the optimal route, i.e. on the replaced stretch, reported before the segment began at 17:38 and still listed within the trip window (17:17–18:06); the code trace confirms the incident falls within 300 m of optimal km 7.1–8.7 [F13][F3][RD-4]. The driver's post-trip statement F10 ("lanes were blocked, so I went round it") is only a statement and cannot itself exempt or establish consent, but the objective traffic record does the work here [F10][RD-4][RD-5].

RD-4(b): the band records F11 (Seletar Expressway band 5, 40–49 km/h) and F12 (Tampines Expressway band 4, 30–39 km/h) are nowhere near the RD-4(b) bands 1–2, and under RD-4(b) a band record cannot exempt a segment on its own; they are at most weak corroboration and I do not rely on them [F11][F12][RD-4].

RD-2 arithmetic, if any part had been unexempt: unexempt extra_km × this trip's per-km rate = distance_fare ÷ distance_km = $31.37 ÷ 22.25 km = $1.4099/km; 4.92 km × $1.4099/km = $6.94, which is the rider's revised ask [F3][F4][F6][RD-2]. Because the only segment is exempt, no amount is payable and the excess-distance line billed ($7.19 for 5.10 km, F4) is not disturbed [F4][F6][RD-2].

FARE-1: nothing unpublished or unearned was added — base $3.90, distance $31.37, time $8.78, waiting $0.00, platform $1.47, surge 1.0× [F4][F5][F6][FARE-1].

RD-6: the trace records route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0; the driver's 2 upheld disputes are non-route matters, so albeit the RD-1 duty was breached in the sense that the driver rerouted without telling the rider in-app, there is no repeated route breach and no account flag [F16][RD-6]. I follow the trace's mapping here (repeated breach → flag_account) and do not levy an account action on a profile that never decides a case.

Accepted: RD-4 is an objective cause test, so the absence of a pre-reroute driver message asking to change route does not defeat the exemption supplied by F13 [F10][F13][RD-4].

The RD-2 formula would be limited to the unexempt segment's extra_km at the trip rate ($31.37 ÷ 22.25 km = $1.4099/km; 4.92 km × $1.4099/km = $6.94), but no amount is due because the only segment is exempt; base, time, platform fee and the deviation-free mileage are undisturbed [F3][F4][F6][RD-2].
